turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty-five minutes, and I'd like to know why my son found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class.
Thanks for coming in.
I didn't come to be thanked, Hale. Who decided to enter the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
I wanted to talk about Owen's essay.
Then talk about it, Hale. You still haven't told me who decided, or what the zero is based on.
How has his semester been at home?
That's not what I came here to discuss, Hale. His home life isn't evidence. What is the zero based on?
He seems tired in class lately.
"Seems tired." That's an impression, Hale, not a document. He's seventeen and he works, and tired isn't a reason to put a zero on his record. What else do you have?
I know he works at the grocery store.
Plenty of seventeen-year-olds work, Hale. A part-time job isn't misconduct. Get to the point, because I'm watching the clock.
The essay came in on time, which was good.
Then it was on time, and it was good, and he still got a zero. Which is it, Hale: is there a problem with the essay, or isn't there?
I did have some concerns about it though.
"Some concerns." Specific ones, Hale, with dates, or I'm writing down that you have none. And procedure 4.1 says you speak with the student first, so did you?
The school's checker flagged it.

A machine's guess. Even the company that sells it says it shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student, and your own procedure 4.3 says software alone doesn't establish a concern. So what else do you have, Hale?
I know those tools aren't perfect.
Then you know the zero has nothing under it, Hale. Withdraw it.
I also looked at the version history.
Okay. What does it show, Hale, and when? I'm writing this down.
It was created very late the night before.
"Very late" isn't a time, Hale. Give me the exact date and the exact time on that history. And Owen wrote that essay over the weekend.
Most of it arrived in two big pieces.
"Two big pieces." People draft in other places and move it over, Hale, and that proves nothing about who wrote it. You've given me no date and no time yet. Turn the screen around.
I asked Owen about his thesis afterward.
"Afterward." After the zero went in, Hale? Procedure 4.1 says you speak with him before. And what did he say?
He had trouble explaining it.
"Trouble explaining it." That's your impression, Hale, of a seventeen-year-old put on the spot by his teacher. Was anyone else in the room, and is it written down anywhere?
I'm not trying to get him in trouble.
Hale, there's a zero in his gradebook. He's already in trouble. Take it off.
What do you think should happen next?
You're asking me to do your job, Hale? The zero comes off today, and Owen gets an apology. If it doesn't, I'm going upstairs to the principal when we're done.
What would you do if you were me?
I'm not sitting in your chair, Hale, and I won't tell you how to sit in it. I've told you what I want. I have ten minutes.
Okay. Let's talk about the rewrite option.
Not yet, Hale. Nothing you've said has put a date or a time in front of me that I can check, and the zero is still in the gradebook. Withdraw it first, then we'll discuss terms.
It would be at lunch, in my room.
I haven't agreed to any rewrite, Hale. Lunch in your room doesn't change that the zero is still sitting there. Withdraw it, then put the rest in writing.
Nothing goes on file if it holds up.
"If it holds up." That's a condition, Hale, not a promise. I'm writing it down, and the zero is still in the gradebook.
Can you summarize where we are in a list?
Put it in an email yourself, Hale. My terms are the same: the zero comes off, Owen gets an apology, and nothing goes on his record.
Thanks for your time.
I didn't come for thanks, Hale. I'm still waiting on an answer: does the zero come off? Two minutes.
